result.description: UDISE (Unified District Information System for Education) is a comprehensive database of the schools in India, which covers over 1.5 million schools, 9.6 million teachers, and 264 million children. It is a management information system that collects, collates, and disseminates data related to various aspects of school education.
result.methodology: UDISE collects data for schools, teachers, enrolment, and vocational education as per the Data Capture Format (DCF), which is a standardized format developed by the Ministry of Education, Government of India.
